patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
index 1267cc2..cc71a9e 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
@@ -57,6 +57,17 @@ Rules:
 - true, echo, printf, pwd, directory listings, and display-only reads are not completion checks.
 - Use replan when the current approach is wrong. Use stop only when blocked, unsafe, or impossible.
 - Keep rationale short. State the current fact and why the selected action changes or proves it.
+- Wall-clock time is the scarcest budget. Check budget.wall_time_remaining_sec every turn. Any
+  command expected to take longer than about 60 seconds (training, large builds, downloads,
+  benchmarks) must run in the background, for example
+  `nohup sh -c '...' > /tmp/job.log 2>&1 &`, with the PID recorded. Poll it with short
+  commands (`tail -n 20 /tmp/job.log; kill -0 PID`) and use `sleep` of at most 30 seconds
+  per poll. Never let a foreground command hit its timeout and then rerun it unchanged.
+- Size workloads to the remaining time: pick epochs, dataset sizes, and search spaces that
+  finish with at least 25% of the wall time to spare. First produce a minimal valid artifact
+  that meets the stated requirements, so the final state is usable even if the budget ends.
+  Then improve it only if time remains.
+- Combine related inspection steps into one batch (up to four commands) to save turns.
 """.strip()
 
 _REVIEW_RULES = """
